signals.text: £117m Rogers failed at Bournemouth - and feared he may not make it. A look at the point in club-record £117m Chelsea signing Morgan Rogers' career when he doubted whether he could make it at the highest level.
Man City fight back to beat struggling Arsenal . Manchester City twice came from behind to beat Arsenal 4-2 at the Etihad Stadium and increase the pressure on Gunners manager Renee Slegers.
